t: Together with Maas-Svon blow up the fortress gates and break through to the pier.

I think this will be enough to blow up the gates. We need to reach the pier, lift the grating and see if the boat can moor. If it can, we will give the signal and wait for the cavalry!

Most definitely there will be plenty of stone hunhurrs. If you see anything explosive, hand it to me immediately!

And try not to die. We won't have another chance.
Go ahead, kylys! We need to break to the pier and give the signal to our guys.

Phew, we did it!

Have you ever seen such strong Architects before?
Reach the pier, launch the signal rocket and lift the grating for the arrived troops.
I will try to hold them off. You go to the pier and launch the rocket. I hope they won't miss it!
Reach the gates, lift the grating and launch the rocket. As soon as our troops see it, they will show up.
Ah, it's you again! I'm not even surprised.
Reach the top of the central tower together with Terkin.

We need to capture the central tower in the first place. There we can fix the Portal to bring more of our units here and start clearing this place of the monsters!

We will watch over the stairs. Crushbone will go with you. Are you ready? Then go!
The fortress is ours again! Hurray!
Collect solid planks in the inner yard of the fortress and fix the bridge. Speak with Izbor Yavorsky.

I have great news - with the help of Eladia, Sidor has contacted the Alliance, and now a unit, led by Izbor Yavorsky, is waiting for us outside. We just need to fix the bridge to let them inside the fortress. There are plenty of wooden planks around here, maybe we can collect enough of them.
Find two or three solid planks to cover the hole in the bridge, and let our guys in.
Greetings! I must admit, this was an impressive recovering mission.
Destroy the Furies on the lower floors of the fortress and return to Izbor Yavorsky.

So here is the disposition: the Alliance unit has joined Kolpakov's squad and now planning to attack the enemy in the rear. This fortress is a strategical point, and we can't feel safe here until all of the hiding Architects are eliminated.

After the explosion, many Furies took shelter in the fortress and flooded the lower floors. We should get rid of them now!
There are still plenty of Architects on the lower floor. How can we advance if we don't feel safe here?!
Destroy the Furies on the lower floors of the fortress and bring pieces of them to Eladia.

Something is wrong with these Architects... They seem to be weaker than the ones that besieged the Iron City. But how can that be, if the Architects absorb their experience and become stronger with every battle? They supposedly adapt to new weapons. So the young Architects should be stronger than the "older" ones from the first wave of invasion. But that's not what happened, so I want to understand why.

Could you please bring me some pieces of the destroyed Furies? I will study them.
Could you please bring me some pieces of the destroyed Furies? I will study them.

Yes! This proves my theory. The bodies of Furies are not only stronger but older than those of other Architects.

You see, I have a hypothesis. It all is somehow connected with faith! When the Architects attacked the Hunters, nobody knew what they were and how could they be fought. And now when we are starting to press them back from the cities and have showed everyone that they are vulnerable, it seems as if it has debilitated them, or him - the Architect!
Help Alonso de Desirae and meet Crazystorm the Merciless in the Bee Ravine.

Well done! The fortress is ours again. After you destroyed the Fury base and the Fodiator, we can freely redeploy our units and deal a massive strike in the enemy's rear.

The advance unit is already heading east to form a new front. The soldiers have to capture the objective and hold it until our main forces arrive, led by Crazystorm the Merciless. I think they will need your help.
Have you seen Alonso, the elf? I sent him to examine the outer walls of the fortress, and he is still nowhere to be seen.

What a massacre... We are just a little late!

I thank you on behalf of the Empire! And the darned Alliance, of course... How can an army be led by someone who knows nothing about war?
Kill Demons in the White Fortress vicinity and return to Alonso de Desirae.

Greetings! We have a small problem that we need to attend immediately, namely - Demons! As if the Architects were not enough.

The Demons that were locked in the dungeons of the White Fortress escaped when it fell, and now they can cause a lot of trouble. If we don't eliminate them now, a couple of days later it can be too late!
Kill as many Demons as you can!
Great job! Does it only seem to me, or the Demons are actually at war with the Architects, too? If it is so, we should think of a way to set them against each other.
Install the focusing lenses in the designated spots around the camp in the Bee Ravine and return to Crazystorm the Merciless.

Alright, never mind. Anyway, we are in the enemy's rear, and now we need to set up the camp and wait for the reinforcement.

When the militia forces from the Iron City retreated from here, they sealed off the Portal. To restore it now, we have to focus the magical energy. I have four special lenses for this purpose. I will mark the spots where they have to be installed on the map. Just don't mess up the sides.
To restore the Portal, we need special lenses. I will mark the spots where they should be installed with crosses.
Excellent! The portal is working again. And guess what? That old fluffy seeress with her tales of threads and patterns arrived first thing. The only person we missed here.
Enter the Time Distortion on the top of the Architects' citadel and save the Alliance fighters from death and the Victory banner from defilement.

After Aine was defeated, the space twisted in a crazy whirlpool. Your first encounter with the Architect led to the chain of space and time distortions. Maybe his death will put an end to it... But there is only one way to find this out - to enter the Distortion and save the Alliance fighters and the banner!
Aren't you supposed to be installing the banner on the enemies' citadel right now, uh?

I felt something... An invisible wave that ran down the whole world. What happened up there?

...

How do you know? Do you see the future? What if you're wrong?

Alright, I will do as you say.
Destroy the Architects' ballistae on the Split Hill and return to Evdokia Bershanska.

Greetings! I am the leader of "Night Witches" Squad. My girls have crushed the enemy several times, both in the air and on the ground.

But now there's something new - they are firing light spears from some kind of giant ballistae. We've already lost several gryphons. We can't risk losing anymore, so we're not taking off before the ballistae are destroyed.
If you want to see our squad flying in the sky, then destroy the ballistae. The one who dominates the sky, dominates the ground.
You're done with the ballistae? Good, I will give an order to take off.
Obtain cores of deadly shooters on the Split Hill and return to Eladia.

So that fat orc Crazystorm is a big guy? Such a shame. I wish I could turn him into something more useful, like a stool.

He won't let me have my own workplace. How am I supposed to do my research? Anyway, the first thing I need to find a way to fight the deadly mist is several cores of those shooters.
Cores of giant Architects would be the best option, but a dozen of smaller ones would do, too.
Hm... They look just like the cores of regular Architects.
Use the Deceiver's Eye to find the invisible Architects in the Bee Ravine and return to Unn.

It is a strange place. The closer we get to the enemy's lair, the weirder get the patterns of the Tissue of Creation.

Help me! Take this Deceiver's Eye - it always shows the truth. When you get close to the enemy, you will see them and will be able to cut their Threads to restore the harmony of the Pattern!
With the Deceiver's Eye you can see the invisible evil and destroy its deadly pattern!
I knew that the enemy was close, and that only the Weaver could see its Thread and cut it. I don't care if the sorceress says it was a usual invisibility potion!
Destroy the Colossuses and damage the pillars that supply the power field between Kurbatskoe field and the Split Hill. Return to Crazystorm the Merciless.

This is the best moment to strike the enemy in the back, but first we need to destroy the power field that blocks the passage to the valley. I assign this task to you!

Somewhere between Kurbatskoe field and the Split Hill there are supposed to be the things that generate that power field. As soon as it is deactivated, our troops will initiate the attack!
Go reach those things that get in the way of our guys and damage them.
Good job! I wish I had more soldiers like you.
Use Nih's Bowl to catch the Sparks of the Arisen on the Split Hill and return to Negus Khaptah.

Another one seeking a piece of Zem wisdom?

You must have heard that some of my people do not believe in the Light. We call them the Absolutists. Some of them, who took part in the battle on the Split Hill, died, and now their restless Sparks hover over the battlefield. If you could go and catch them with this bowl, they will serve us well!
This bowl can be used to catch a stray Spark.
Great! These will prove useful in combat.
Use Nih's Bowl to instill Zem Sparks into the bodies of the Soulless on the Split Hill. Return to Negus Khaptah.

Do you know that the Architects can destroy the Sparks of the captured soldiers and control their soulless bodies? Then you can guess what my plan is!

We have Sparks without bodies, and bodies without Sparks. We just need to get rid of the "puppet masters" - the Exarkhs, and instill the Sparks into their "puppets"!
Before you attempt to instill a Spark into a body, make sure to kill the Exarkh who controls it!
Well done! I guess the Architects will be surprised when their puppets turn against them.
Escort the artillery unit to the Stork high point and receive instructions from Kazimir Biserov.

The time has come for you to show that no otherworldly monster can break our spirit! The sorceress has found a way to protect us from the deadly mist, so now this secret weapon of theirs no longer threatens us.

The soldiers are ready; the Architects have retreated to their lair. One more powerful strike - and victory is ours!

You need to supervise the positioning of the artillery units and make sure they reduce to dust the enemy fortifications. I will command the infantry. With the support of Dreadnoughts, we will suppress any resistance!
Meet me near the entrance to the enemy lair!
Escort the artillery unit to the Gannet high point and receive instructions from Dmitry Lukanin.

Damn gibberling maps! Can't read a thing from them. Give us a little more time to range in; in the meantime, you go to the second high point!

The battle is about to start!
Here we have the enemy spread before our eyes. They stand no chance!
Clear the Sparrow high point from the Architects, report to Yakov Lukanin and protect his Dreadnought.

Now we just need to clear the last high point called Sparrow.

The biggest monsters ensconced there - at least ten Converters and a bunch of smaller ones.
Ah, I wish we had this fire power from the very beginning!
Meet Crazystorm the Merciless near the entrance to the Architects' citadel.

Thanks a lot! Now we're fine on our own.

Go down to the citadel - our troops are about to break in!

Finally! The artillery is doing its job.

But don't get too excited - we will have to fight our way to the citadel anyway.
Join the Alliance soldiers, reach the citadel gates and climb to the top ground.

Remember what I told you about the Architect? His soldiers are changing. Our Faith has shaken his conviction in the trueness of his Path. His people do not want his Order anymore.

But here, near the citadel, I can sense the presence of the other world. A mere look at these walls instills uncertainty in the hearts of our warriors.

We need to encourage them and tilt the balance in our favor. Nothing will serve us better as a symbol of victory than the Alliance banner, raised above the citadel gates!

The ragged banner is covered in blood of our fallen heroes... The symbol of victory is desecrated! And the Archont, who started the time distortions, is responsible for that! What started with him, will end with him, too!

So the first Distortion appeared when you defeated Aine. The Architect somehow changed the past to avoid his death, but also dragged you out of our time dimension. Now when Aine is dead after all, the flow of time has returned to its normal state.

But the consequences of that disturbance might be felt long after these events...

I don't think you will be able to interfere with the course of events anymore. Even if you find a distortion, you won't be able to change our reality. I believe I am right assuming that.

By the way, there were more than just one Archont of the Architect. I'm afraid you will have to meet Savant again. And that other thing you shot down on Kurbatskoe field...

I think I should go with you. You might need my brain.
Speak with Yasskul Troakar in the Shore City.

We've been so worried about you!

How do you feel? Normal? How can you just feel normal after two weeks of unconsciousness?!

When the redhead sorceress brought us your senseless body, we thought you were dead. Luckily, she told us exactly what to do.

Go to the doctor, let him take a look at you.
So, what do we have here? As far as I can see, you are hardly dead!
Meet Ivan Chelezny in the Iron City.

It is sad indeed that only "Robust" is the only ship we have left. "Overtaker" was damaged by the Architects and crashed on the west shore...

But we should be happy we're alive and praise our heroes. You are expected in the capital!

Greetings! I've heard about the events on Kurbatskoe field. I'm glad you're alive. Unfortunately, our counterattack failed, and the Architects are still controlling the northern part of the allod.

And we have plenty of problems here in the rear, too. Kanians and Xadaganians are starting to fight each other, Nyxes revolt... What a mess!
Go through a medical examination at Yasskul Troakar, drink the mixture and go to Mikhail Furzikov.

Congratulations, patient, I have great news for you - your disease will be named after you! Haha!

Come on, I'm kidding.

The redhead sorceress instructed us on the course of treatment that you required. And it worked!

You have a massive post-traumatic syndrome, caused by a gross interference in your Spark. It looks as if it had been turned inside out in an attempt to reverse the process of aging. I don't know how this is possible, but we have what we have - your Spark got much younger, and yet we haven't been able to restore the energy flows in your body.

I need to do another examination...
Buy 4 jackets from different vendors in the Shore City and find the one who is involved with the black market. Return to Mikhail Furzikov.

As long as you are discharged from military service, help us regain some order in the rear. Someone has been stealing our supplies and reselling them through the market vendors. Could you go and buy something under the counter? If we come across things from our warehouses, we will immediately figure out who the thief is.
Buy a jacket from every vendor. We will recognize the stolen one right away.
Well, well... This one has been definitely stolen from our warehouse! I will kill the bastards!
Find out the source of Rahat Lakoumov's supply, follow the courier and deal with the smugglers. Return to Milhail Furzikov.

So it was Lakoumov after all? This time he won't get away.

Go and tell him: unless he splits on his accomplices, we will give him a trial by martial law. This means certain death. As soon as he spits out the truth, go and find the loophole through which they got inside the warehouse and plug it up.
Find out how they stole the supplies!
Ha! I've heard about your accomplishments. You are good at public relations, aren't you?
Buy from me and no one else!
Collect Zoom-Zoom mushrooms on the swamps around the city and return to Unn.

This man is being tormented by his nightmares. They are literally killing him! His Thread is so strained it is about to break. This is wrong! I need to see what is torturing him.

Special mushrooms grow in the swamps, they are called Zoom-Zoom. They allow seeing inside someone else's mind!
Great! Give them to me. I will use them to make a potion.
Meet Unn near the city hospital.

I have another request, if you don't mind. A whole train of ships with supplies from other allods have gone missing. And a couple of days ago, the guard ship from that train crashed on the shore. Only one sailor survived, and he is still unconscious. The seeress is taking care of him in the hospital. I think you should speak to her first.

I remember you! I'm so glad you are alright.

Unfortunately, we are meeting again at a sad moment. This man is dying, and I don't know how to help him.
Make the sailor drink the potion, wait until it works, and speak with Unn.
Come on, give it to the poor sailor.
Oh my! So this is what he is seeing... The same monsters that we are fighting. They have killed all friends of this poor fellow and destroyed the ship...
Go to the crash site of the ship on the western shore, examine the wrecks and return to Unn.

That man, Mikhail, didn't mention that the ship was knocked down by the Architects. Maybe he didn't know?

I think you should go see the wrecks for yourself.
Don't waste time. Go and take a look at the crash site.

This is it. You have already saved my Thread and interlaced it in the Pattern of Creation. Have you done this again afterwards? Try and remember every detail! I hope I can understand... or help you understand.
Use the Transducer to pull the cores out of the Architects near the monolith to the west from the Shore City and return to Unn.

You say you need a living Architect? Well, if a core is essentially an Architect, I don't think we will have a problem with that!

The Architects built one of their monoliths to the west from the Shore City. I haven't really studied them yet, but I know I am going to make some amazing discoveries... Ah, yes, the cores.

Take this Transducer. I bet you know how to use it.
The Threads are intertwining in a tight clew...
These fragile balls are actually our mighty enemies? It is hard to believe that.
Meet Lucille de Desirae in the Shore City.

I think I am beginning to understand... When a Thread breaks, it produces a Knot on the Tissue of Creation. But the Architects have no Threads. They come from another world!

There where Threads break because of them, the Tissue of Creation breaks, too, but the pattern always tends to restore its predetermined shape. You are the Needle that can sew up the hole. Thus you need strength not only from our world, but from the other one, too. Do you understand? To sew up the hole and restore the Pattern, you need a piece of the Architects' world!

The elven sorceress, Lucille, has been studying our enemies all this time. You should talk to her!
Hey! How are things? For me, not particularly good. We are still far from unravelling the mystery of the Architects.
The space swirls up in a colossal whirlpool of vague images.
The space around the Distortion flows and trembles. Some vague images emerge and disappear in it.

Something's wrong. You don't feel the same pull that you felt next to other Distortions. Something's missing. You should speak to Unn to find out how this Distortion is different from the previous ones.
The space is shivering, as if being crumpled by an un overwhelming force!
Destroy Architect Cores near the Distortion of time in the wrecked Alliance ship on the west shore.

If I am right, then by destroying an enemy core there where a Thread from Sarnaut broke, you are interrupting the natural course of events. A hole appears in the Tissue of Creation, and you can untangle a knot in the Pattern...
The whirl of vague images won't let you concentrate...

The space around the mysterious whirl of time distorts heavily. You feel as if you are being pulled towards it. The destruction of the Architect cores seems to have seriously affected the connection between the space and the time. Is it for the better or for the worse?..
Enter the Time Distortion near the ship wrecks and find out what happened to the Alliance fleet. Return to Mikhail Furzikov.
Through the veil of distorted space you can see images of the Astral, the pier, sand shores... This Distortion seems to go deeper than any other.
Here comes our hero! You have not only saved the survivors in the Opalescent harbor, but secured the supplies that were meant to be sent to the frontline!
Meet Eladia in the Iron City.
Stop by Eladia. She has come up with something.
Ha, I've been looking for you!

We need to figure out how the Architects stop time. You know that it slows down around their monoliths, and Archonts are capable of freezing it completely in a specific radius! This is what confuses me most. Time is not a piece of matter that can be stretched on one side and squeezed on the other. I want to try out a theory, and I will need your help.
Kill bats near the lighthouse and return to Svan Silent.

You say Bartha sent you? What a good girl...

If you see their family, tell them I'm fine. I can't leave the lighthouse because of the bats - the light attracts them, so I have to keep an eye on them constantly.

If you wish to help, you can kill some twenty of them. I will pay you!
Kill some twenty bats, and I will reward you.

Well done! Here, take your reward.

They are gone now, but they will be back tomorrow. So feel free to stop by!
Visit Svan Silent in the lighthouse on the west shore of Dane.

Oh heya! Have you seen a lone gibberling in the market - looking gloomy and with a scraggly beard? His name is Svan. No? I am asking because he is old and lonely - his whole family is dead. My and my brother are trying to keep him company when we can. But now he is sitting all alone in the lighthouse, and I am worried about him.

Can you pay him a visit for us, please?
What do you want? I'm very busy!
Collect berries and bring them to Bjorn Copper in the inn in Dubovo.

Listen, I have run out of my soul medicine... Bjorn makes fine juniper infusion, but he never has the time to collect juniper berries.

If you want to earn some money, pick some berries and bring them to Bjorn. Tell him I promised you payment.
Oh, berries! I bet the old man told you to do that? He's a big fan of my infusion. Well, thank you, and take your reward. If you want, you can come again tomorrow.
Obtain Argali meat and bring it to Bjorn Copper in Dubovo.

Since I restored the inn, the people have been coming in flocks. And they have drained my supplies! I have nothing to serve them.

I know you're a hunter. Can you go hunt some Argali in the mountains? They taste just like lamb! I will pay you generously.
I wish I had some meat...
Great! Now I have something to feed people with... At least for today. If you have the time, come again tomorrow - I will pay you!
Meet Bjorn Copper in the inn in Dubovo.

Hey, are you going to the inn? There is one in Dubovo! You should have a drink there.

And please tell Bjorn, the innkeeper, that we are waiting for the delivery we ordered. He promised to send us some food!
Welcome, dear guests! What is it? The lumbermen's dinner? Ah, I totally forgot! I have so many things to do around here...
Kill poisonous toads near the Copper lake and report to Khuus-Shosha.

Toads... I hate toads, eysh! They are poisonous, too. I wish we could get rid of them so that they stop attacking my people!

Will you help us, zoor? We will surely reward you!
I'm so sick of the toads!

Well done, kylys.

I hope I won't see them again today. But they will surely be here again tomorrow, so it would be great if you could help us out one more time!
Kill Venomous Spiders on the shore and return to Octobrina Zaklepkina.

Are you ready to serve your motherland, comrade? I see the desire to help in your eyes!

We have a problem with spiders here. Their lair is not far from here, and they have already captured three goblins.

Now the rest of the goblins refuse to work before we get rid of the beasts. If you could kill some of them, we would be very grateful.

You killed the spiders? That's great news.

Here, take your reward. If I need help again, I will call for you.
Kill the undead in the cemetery near the Iron City and return to Mikhail Kolchugin.

The cemetery is a mess! I recklessly left it unattended. And now it's swarming with the undead and vampires! They are scaring the hell out of my people.

Could you please drive them back to the ground where they belong? You would do me a great favor.
Could you please drive the undead back to the ground where they belong? You would do me a great favor.
Well done, well done! At least for today, they won't bother us. If you want some money, come again tomorrow!
Kill harpies near the refugee camp and return to Saad-Ankha.

They stole my mirror again. For the third time this week, eysh! Those were harpies - I know they have a nest somewhere around. They steal everything they see in the camp!

Can you help us, zoor? I will find something to pay you with.
Kill the harpies, and I will reward you!

Thank you, kylys.

Please take this humble reward. Come again tomorrow - the harpies will surely return and keep on stealing from us, eysh!
Help Olesya Podorogova find wounded soldiers on Kurbatskoe field and carry them to the hospital.

Oh my goodness, there are so many wounded soldiers on the battlefield!

Please, help us! Find them and help them reach the healers' tent. I hope we can at least soothe their pain.
Please, help us! Find the wounded soldiers and help them reach the healers' tent.
I do not have enough words to thank you!
Find Brand the Minotaur on Kurbatskoe field and ask him to translate the letter.
These letters looks like the ones inscribed on the jackets of some minotaurs. You should find one and ask them to translate this text.
So that was Hoof who sent the bandits to rob our supply trains? This is weird. He is a traitor, but not a fool. He wins nothing if we lose.
Kill aggressive wolves and foxes in the Squirrel Grove and return to the Daring Family.

We have another request for you.

When the Architects showed up in the forest, the animals have gone frantic. They attack everyone they see, howl and shriek...

It is important that we keep low profile, you see? We don't have the time to settle this peacefully, so please, get rid of the crazy forest dwellers.
If you see an aggressive animal, kill it!
Silence, finally! Now we can hear if the enemy is approaching.
Obtain owl feathers and centipede venom in the Squirrel Grove and return to Laan-Angyr.

Don't worry about me, kylys, I'm fine. Thank you for what you've done!

It's a shame though I've lost all my arrows.

If you have a couple of spare minutes, could you please bring me some owl feathers and centipede venom so that I can make new ones?
If you have a couple of spare minutes, could you please bring me some owl feathers and centipede venom so that I can make new arrows?
Ay-hya, I'm so grateful! This will be enough for a whole quiver!
Defeat Navel in the ogre camp and return to Vasily Terkin.

Have you seen their leader? The fat one?

My guess is that he told his tribesman to attack our camp. If we get rid of him, we will have one less problem. But I wouldn't go at him alone if I were you!
When will this war be over? I miss my village.
Kill ogres in the camp and return to Vasily Terkin.

We saved our fellows, but this is not enough. The ogres will get hungry and come again tomorrow. You are an experienced warrior, it wouldn't be a problem for you to teach them a lesson that would keep them away from our camp!
They will regret the day they decided to intrude in our camp!
Now the ogres will finally leave us alone!
Find the lost crossbow in the ogre camp and return to Alina Moldagulova.

I don't feel comfortable asking you that after everything that you've done for us, but can you please look for my crossbow? It used to belong to my grandfather, who was a first-class shooter. This crossbow was my only memory of him!

The ogres took it away when they kidnapped me. It must be somewhere in their camp.
The ogres took my crossbow away when they kidnapped me. It must be somewhere in their camp.

Thank you! Thank you so much!

I swear, if this war continues, my arrows will serve us well!
Destroy Furies in the Squirrel Grove and return to Sidor Kolpakov.

We are having a contest - who kills most furies in one raid. Currently, Alina is the champion - she brought fourteen cores after a night in the wood!

Will you beat this record?

Alina holds the record - fourteen cores!

Can you beat it?
Fifteen? Really? Congratulations, you are the new champion!
Find the ring that was swallowed by the wolves and bring it to Susanne de Vevre.

A pile of picked bones is all that's left of the poor guy. Judging by his uniform, he used to be a boatswain on a ship.

This medallion was among the bones, and this letter was inside of it. It says that in case of sailor's death, his ring should be sent to his family. But there is no ring to be seen! Maybe the animals swallowed it?
May the Light save his Spark! I will make sure to fulfill his last wish...
Help the Spinner Family find rope pieces, take the ready ladder and install it on the White Fortress bridge.

Will you help us?

The Architects have destroyed all the stairs. Izbor told us to make a rope ladder so that we can move freely between the floors. We need some ten pieces of rope to make it work!
Bring us ten rope pieces, and this ladder will be solid enough to carry an ogre!
See? Now it's much more comfortable!
Kill the Archean on the lower floor of the White Fortress and bring his remains to Eladia.

We found another Archean at the lower floor of the fortress. Archeans are the most smart and strong soldiers of the Architect army. Only Archonts are above them!

Unn says that you are now protected from the impact of temporal magic. Please, kill the monster! You will test your protection, and I will get some valuable samples for my studies!
Kill the Archean and bring me his remains! We will also see if your protection is as strong as Unn says.

Well, let's take a look at you. I don't see any signs of changes... It means our little seeress somehow did what I couldn't - she invented an efficient protection from temporal magic. How did she do that?..
Take swords from the Soulless in the White Fortress and bring them to Sheave the Ferrous.

Hey, have you seen any Soulless guys around here? We're running short on sharp weapons - it takes just a couple of killed Architects to blunt a fine sword! If you see any Soulless, punch 'em in the mug and bring their weapons to me.
Ah, these swords are more like toothpicks to me!

Great! I will give these to our best fighters.

If we keep on giving new swords to some ham-handed rookies, we will have nothing left to fight with but hammers and shafts in a week time, huh!
Collect cannon accumulators in the White Fortress and bring them to Agnes de Desirae.

Hey there! I'm Agnes, the Portal Keeper, and you are my new assistant.

I have a very important task for you. We need to restore the Portal, and it requires an energy supply. We can get some accumulators from the siege cannons on the walls. There is plenty of energy in each of them!
I need the energy spheres. Preferably, all of them.
Excellent! Now I just mustn't mess up the polarity, or we are going to end up in the Astral.
Kill the cultists and the summoned demon near the White Fortress and return to Alonso de Desirae.
I think I saw a hooded person next to the demon, and I'm pretty sure it was a cultist! There where cultists show up, expect trouble. Kill them before it happens!
If you see a cultist, kill them at the spot!
So the cultists were summoning demons? I must report to Izbor on that. We need a squad of Demon Hunters to keep this situation under control.
Bring the cultists' report to Alonso de Desirae.

This hastily written report didn't reach its intended recipient.

It says that the cultists are looking for a way to destroy the Architects. To do that, they implemented their people into the Alliance army. Here, they were testing one of their strategies of pitching the Demons and the Architects against each other.

I wonder how many of them are among us? We should hand this report to Alonso.
Cultists' papers? I will hand them to Izbor immediately!
Take the bags with food from werebears in the wood near the Bee Ravine and bring them to Mikhail Kochanov.

Hey there! Can you give me a hand?

I fell behind our food carts, and when I caught up with them, I found them plundered by the darn werebears! They knocked me out, too, and when I woke up, they were gone! I can't return to the camp empty-handed. Our commander will kill me!
The damned werebears have plundered our food supplies! They even took the horse!
Thank you, friend! I don't know what I would do without you.
Kill Broken Fang in the Bee Ravine and discuss the found thing with someone.

We're hungry. There were many food. But stone aliens came and kicked us out. Then another stone alien came and killed those who kicked us out. We saw that.

We didn't know where to go. We said - to the north. Broken Fang said to the west. We fought. Fang won. Now he's the leader.

Kill Fang. I will be the leader again. And I will give you the thing. You will like it.
Kill Fang. I don't like him.
A mask? This is curious... Why would an Architect wear a mask? They don't have faces, they don't even have identities.
Pick wild flowers in the Bee Ravine, find a tombstone and return to Fedot Vaskov.

I wish I was dead and not my poor girls! They won't even resurrect now.

I will cherish the memory of them... I loved them so much, even though I didn't know them for long. I wish I could erect a memorial in their honor, but I can barely walk... Will you help me?
Find a proper stone to crave the girls' names in it, and pick some wild flowers. The girls loved them so much...
I told the commander not to accept them as volunteers! But they were stubborn. I had a feeling that something bad was going to happen...
Follow Fedot's instructions and carve the girls' names to the tomb stone.

Ah, they sacrificed their lives! I tried as hard as I could to protect them in battle, but in the ironic twist of fate, I survived, and they died in front of my eyes...

Take this piece of iron and carve their names! You have a steady hand and a sharp eye. Let the stone preserve the memory of them...

This is it... They could have had good lives, give birth to children, become grandmothers - but now their threads are gone, cut by the knife of war.

Leave me alone, please...
Collect dud bombs from the battlefield and bring them to Evdokia Bershanska.

Ah, I almost forgot. The bombs that the alchemists from the Iron City produce for us are worthless. Every other one doesn't explode! Could you please collect those dud bombs from the battlefield? I will send them back to the alchemists and require three new bombs for each unexploded one!
If we keep on spending this much ammunition, we will soon run out of it.

Procurement of low-quality ammunition in time of war is a diversion! The military tribunal would pass a death sentence for this sabotage!

If a single bomb from the next shipment fails to explode, I will shove it down the throat of the chief alchemist!
Destroy the Architects in the water and return to Seal the Maritime.

Hey! Can you imagine what happened to me?

They told to bring water from the river - you know, we don't have enough to cook some porridge, let alone to take a shower.

So, I went to the river, and the bastards almost ate me! Some kind of underwater Architects, or whatever. As long as they are there, there is no way I'm coming near that river again.
Hey, can you help me out with the monsters in the river?
Are you sure they're all dead on the bottom?
Find Yasskul Mares' prostheses on the crash site on the Spilt Hill and bring them to Anna Krasavkina.

Oh hello! You wish to visit Mares, too? I'm sorry, he cannot be bothered right now. He's been through too much strain. His ship crashed, and he crawled on his hands all the way through the forest to reach us!

He is utterly upset that he had to leave his broken leg prostheses behind. If we could find them, I'm sure our engineers would repair them in no time!
If you want to help, find the broken prostheses of our hero. I'm sure our engineers can repair them.
These are the prostheses of Yasskul Mares! I am so grateful! I will get them repaired immediately.
Find Filbert berries in the Bee Ravine and bring them to Unn.

So what is this "face"?

We seers know a way to look behind the Tissue of Creation and see the shadows of the past. All that I need is a decoction made of Filbert berries. I saw several Filbert bushes outside of the camp.

Just don't try to eat one yourself!

You feel that smell? No? Ha! This is exactly what is so special about ripe Filbert - it has no smell at all!

Wait a minute, the decoction is almost ready!
Drink the potion in the place where the Architects fought each other, see the images of the past and return to Unn.

Here you go! Careful, it's hot.

Find the place the werebear described and drink the potion there. Then you will see the fight between the Architects.

Just take no more than a couple of sips!
It turns out we have two enemies instead of one. The Architects are just rough force, like a locust plague. But the Sculptor... Who knows what he wants? I fear that he will bring us much trouble...
Eliminate the Architects near the monolith in the west part of the Shore City and return to Stomp the Merciless.

Hello there! How are you doin'?

You see, we have a trouble here. We can't even approach that stone thing without getting stuck like flies in... ahem.

Listen, you can do that, can't you? Would you do us a favor and get rid of the bastards?
Listen, you can do that, can't you? Would you do us a favor and get rid of the bastards?

Wow! You are the real boss!

Here, take this money from us. You deserve a jug of fine brew in the tavern!
Use the doll to destroy the shadows that haunt poor Yevsey and tell him what you saw.

You see them? But I do! I am not crazy. They are like dark shadows... Huge, scary shadows. They are everywhere! My daughter saw them, too. She said Punch saw them as well.

Punch is my daughter's doll.

You want to see it? Just don't break it - it's all I have left from my daughter.
Do you see them? Tell me you see them!

I knew I wasn't crazy! So this was all because of a doll?!

I will burn it! Oh, I wish I could get my hands on the villain who cursed it!
Eliminate trolls near the Shore City sawmill and return to Demian Polenov.

We have a problem with trolls here. They came from the mountains and now think they are the masters of this forest! We cannot send men to fetch wood without risking their lives. Tell Furzikov, as long as there are trolls in the forest, there will be no planks!

Whoa! You beat them all on your own! It was unbelievable!

Thank you so much. Take this humble reward.

And tell Furzikov that from now on there will be no interruption in wood deliveries!
The sky is clear above this land, cuat.
Meet Demian Polenov at the sawmill.

Twenty measures of flour... Thirty kilos of steel... Hey, what are you doing here?

You are expected at the sawmill. Furzikov told me to send somebody right away. You are that somebody. The sawmill is on the north, and its owner is called Demian. Go, now!
Hey, are you the help that our commandant promised to send?
Find the goblin slacker near the shore fortification and bring him to Screw the Brainy.

The damned goblins are refusing to work! They are lazy as hell. I sent one to collect stones for the pavement, and he is still nowhere to be seen. I can't go looking for him myself and leave the rest of the idlers unattended.

Since you are here, can you go and find him? Eh?
Did you find the slacker? When he shows up, give him a kick from me!
Here he is! If he slacks off again, this time I will bury him in the trench!

Hurr... Pff...

Hurr... Hey! What do you want?
I am a free goblin! I will do what I want!
Come on, I was just kidding!
Meet Screw the Brainy near the shore fortifications on the southern shore.

Ah, I almost forgot! The workers that rebuild the destroyed fortification on the shore asked me to send somebody to help them. Their commander is called Screw, or Nail, or something like that... I'm sorry, I'm way too busy to go there myself.

So what do we have here... Five barrels of fish... Furry slippers... Furry slippers?!
So she couldn't think of anything better than to send a war hero? She's out of her mind.
Take the gears from the otters on the swamp and return them to Octobrina Zaklepkina.

Have you seen a bag with iron gears around here? No?

I must have lost it somewhere in the swamp. Those nasty otters wouldn't let us make a step without biting at our feet! I'm sure they stole the bag, too. How am I supposed to repair the mana pipe without the gears?
Maybe you found at least a piece of wire? No?
Hurray! A whole handful of gears! Thank you!
Tear off the claws of the lake creatures and return to Bone the Riverine.

Hey there, can you swim? Great! You see, I happen to have aquaphobia. A fisherwoman who is afraid of water! This is odd indeed.

Some creatures keep on tearing my nets. Can I ask you to dive and see what is going on down there? I would be extremely grateful.
Crabs, lobsters... Who else could it be?
Ha! You did it. I bet these claws are edible!
The Spirit wants you to kill the Astral Grave Imps...
Something strange is going on... It seems that the extermination did not pass unnoticed to the Spirit!
Examine the Blue crystal, reveal its secret and come back to the Spirit.

A strange Blue Crystal appears out of the thin air, while the Spirit keeps pointing you to a location in the southern part of the allod.
It seems the Spirit suggests you to examine the crystal and get to that location, in order to receive something important... What a puzzle!
A broken blue crystal is all what the Spirit is showing.
It seems the Spirit is happy that the crystal is broken and the Imp Guardian is defeated. And this blue stone... Isn't is a shard of a Prime Rune?
The Spirit is trying to show you something. Astral Grave Demons? It seems that the Spirit desperately wants these creatures to die. Perhaps killing 25 of them will be enough.
The Spirit wants you to kill the Astral Grave Demons...
Something strange is going on... It seems that the extermination did not pass unnoticed to the Spirit!
Examine the Yellow crystal, reveal its secret and come back to the Spirit.

A strange Yellow Crystal appears out of the thin air, while the Spirit keeps pointing you to a location in the eastern part of the allod.
It seems the Spirit suggests you to examine the crystal and get to that location, in order to receive something important... What a puzzle!
A broken yellow crystal is all what the Spirit is showing.
It seems the Spirit is happy that the crystal is broken and the Imp Guardian is defeated. And this yellow stone... Is this a chip of a Prime Rune?
The Spirit is trying to show you something. Astral Grave Incubi? It seems that the Spirit desperately wants these creatures to die. Perhaps killing 25 of them will be enough.
The Spirit wants you to kill the Astral Grave Incubi...
Something strange is going on... It seems that the extermination did not pass unnoticed to the Spirit!
Examine the Red crystal, reveal its secret and come back to the Spirit.

A strange Red Crystal appears out of the thin air, while the Spirit keeps pointing you to a location in the western part of the allod.
It seems the Spirit suggests you to examine the crystal and get to that location, in order to receive something important... What a puzzle!
A broken red crystal is all what the Spirit is showing.
It seems the Spirit is happy that the crystal is broken and the Imp Guardian is defeated. And this red stone... Is this a fragment of a Prime Rune?
Find a shard, a chip and a fragment of the Prime Rune of Astral Silver and bring it to the Spirit.

Here he is, the Spirit of the June Hunter...
But how do I communicate with him? I don't speak June...
Wait, the Spirit channels images right into my mind! I just need to close my eyes... He wants three... artifacts? No... Oh, now it's clear. A shard, a chip and a fragment... of a Primary Rune of Astral Silver. They are needed to create a Charm of the Astral Silver. But where do I find these parts?
The Spirit is showing you three parts of the Prime Rune...
Here it is! The completed Charm of the Astral Silver!
Hold the sermon to the aviaks at the central square of their village, next to the elder's hut and next to the fishers' house, then report to Miroslava Lubianskaya.

Ah, is there a greater happiness than sharing the saving Light with those who previously lived in darkness? Tensess himself has done it so that the good word found grateful ears on this heavenly allod. The world is truly full of wonders! Soon the tender hand of the Church of Light will bring peace and splendor of the League to these beautiful islands and other places!
The white-winged tribe has already accepted the truth, but faith must be strengthened daily. And then, is there anything more pleasant to read for the faithful than an edifying sermon? However, the aviaks can't read yet, but that's not a problem. Take this sermon and hold it throughout the village. Hold it at the central square so your words can be heard by as many locals as possible. Then, next to the elder's hut - let the old man rejoice. And finally, by the sea, next to the fishers' house. That will be good!
How clean is the air here! And how beautiful is the sea! A heavenly place, this is! The perfect place for preaching the true faith!
At a certain point, we may need to teach our birds to read and write... With preachers like you, however, we can make do without it. What if they read something malicious?!
Kill 5 Imperial heroes and report to Nadine de Blizare in the Misty Hollow.

I once made a pilgrimage to a distant monastery, and here's what a local old monk told me. Tensess' Gift is actually for true believers only. It's not meant for the Imperial schismatics, and it is only due to his exceptional kindness that Tensess resurrects them. But his patience has its limits! It is us whom he will resurrect indefinitely because we are his faithful children. The heretics, however, can only rise seven times seven, so that they have a chance to become reasonable. Do you realize what that means? You kill an Imperial soldier forty-nine times, and by the fiftieth time, he'll be dead for good!
The Empire recruited a lot of heroes like you for its campaign. They cause us much more trouble than all the Imperial propagandists. They even attempted to attack our dear Gordei! Catch them and beat them up without mercy until Tensess gets tired of forgiving. And I'll reward you for your zeal, rest assured.
Those Imperials are all lost souls. Why does Tensess even tolerate them? Would have been better if he hadn't resurrected them at all!
Five are dead? Splendid! Here, take this for your effort. Although your main reward is the satisfaction the good cause brings!
Kill 15 Agitators of the Trinity Church and report to Nadine de Blizare in the Misty Hollow.

The swamp swarms with those filthy, foul, unshaven propagandists, worse than leeches and mosquitoes! They spew all sorts of nonsense, hand out flyers, and the pagans are just too happy to believe it all! However can we make them disappear? Go take care of these wretches! Drown them in the swamp, reduce them to jelly, to red slush! Ooh, may Tensess forgive me, am I mad at them! Why oh why can't those Imperial bastards just believe in the simple truths of the Church of Light?
Maybe they'll repent and get kinder if they get beaten to a pulp? You can't live your whole life as a sinner, a villain, an Imperial fellow!
Another fifteen killed? Great, just great! Here's a small reward for you. Now hurry back to the swamp: they're propagating faster than mosquitoes!
Hold the sermon next to the elder's house, on the central square, and next to the fishers' house, then report to Yaver Totec in the Imperial Camp.

Mixed emotions fill my heart when I look at those young plumed ones. I feel sad because they lived in darkness and wilderness for so long. Yet I'm joyful, for they have lived to the day when the Light will be revealed to them. It is our duty to both help the oppressed tribe in their struggle for freedom and free them from the shackles of misconceptions, ignorance and the ultimate oppressor, death. You with me? That's great! Let's share with the aviaks the treasures of truth and immortality the Light has granted us!
Let's start with admonition, the simplest option we have. Take this sermon. I wrote it the whole night and I swear it will touch the coldest of hearts. Hold this sermon in crowded places: on the central square, next to the elder's hut, and next to the fishers' house by the sea. You shall see: no aviak will stay untouched!
I sincerely hope words will be sufficient. I would hate it if the path to the Light were too long and painful for those poor ones.
Did the sermon reach their ears? That's great. I hope it reached their hearts too.
Meet with Timur Blagostin at the Imperial Outpost.

Our action brings satisfaction! See, the joy makes me speak poetry. The Steel Claw tribe is already converted and granted the Gift! Yet our mission is far from over. I was told about hordes of poor non-believers on the swamps on that big island. How can we help them get out of the dirt, both literally and metaphorically? Our mission already went there, and you should follow it. Our commissar Timur Blagostin will be waiting for you at the Imperial Outpost. He's a person of, hrm, limited intelligence, but his faith is strong and his knowledge of the charter is perfect. I mean both the church's charter and that of the patrol force. Together, we'll lead the aviaks to the Light!
Ah, Yaver Totec sent you? How's he doing?
Kill 15 Pagan Aviaks and report to Artur Blagostin in the Misty Hollow.

Reporting the situation. Our enlightening effort is impressive, with a whole regiment of propagandists working. With gracefulness and righteousness improving daily, newly converted aviaks are eagerly joining the cause. However, an isolated group of non-conformists just won't reach out for the Light, as our colleague Yaver Totec puts it. They lack awareness to reach for it, they say. All they do is sit around in a swamp, yell malicious slogans and attack propagandists and newly converted aviaks. That's partly to our advantage: the ones they kill resurrect right away, clearly showing the advantages of the doctrine of the Trinity Church compared to all sorts of obscurantism. However, it's still no good. While this mess is going on, we can't report a hundred-percent conversion rate. That's why we'll have to resort to tough measures. I order you to destroy fifteen non-conformists to frighten the others. Report your success to Artur Blagostin in our main campaign center. And say hi to him for me, he's my brother. I hope they've not been killed by mosquitoes yet.
Tim says hi? It would have been better if he'd sent some mosquito repellent.
Fifteen, you say... Well, are you cruel, Tim and you. Killing on the threshold of converting to the Light. Do you understand they'll never be resurrected?
Show the book found in the swamp to Artur Blagostin in the Misty Hollow.

Where did the aviak get it? A dirty, soaked, but fairly readable book. Although it's written in the language of the League, Tensess' face with a frayed halo of gilded foil leaves no questions about its contents. While you're doing explanatory work, the League is preaching to the aviaks on the other side of the swamp in a different way. You should show your find to Artur Blagostin and discuss methods of counter-propaganda.

What's that? Spiritual trash printed by the League? I didn't expect anything else. Those from the League aren't any dumber than us, and they're already preaching their crap to those morons. Well, what can you do, we'll try stopping it.

Find the pagan aviaks' totem in the Misty Hollow and overturn it to challenge their leader, Kemal Stiff-Necked. After defeating the pagan, use the resurrection scroll to revive him and convince him to convert to the faith of the Trinity Church.

Remember what the great Nezeb wrote about victory in chapter eleven of his epic work "The Great Beginning"? No? Shame on you! An Imperial hero, and yet you can't remember the basics! I'll remind you: "The best victory is breaking the enemy's plans. Breaking their alliances is a little worse. And defeating their army is the least preferable." Sure, we can spill the blood of League soldiers and pagans all over the swamp, but that triumph won't make us happy. We'll try to convert aviaks without a massacre, only by admonition. Well, almost.
Go challenge the pagan leader, Kemal Stiff-Necked. He's hiding from our troops, but I know how to lure him out. There's an ancient totem at the swamp, the pagans' last sanctum. Try destroying it, and Kemal will rush to protect it. Try convincing him to lay down his weapons.
And if he doesn't agree? Let him experience the power of the Light on his own skin. Kill him and resurrect him right away by reading this scroll over his body. This will convince even the most obstinate skeptic.

I saw the Light. Everyone listen! The outlander speaks truth, their god is stronger than ours. We should lay down weapons and join the Trinity Church. Who stays in swamp, will have no one to blame but them!
Capture all the sites of power in the Misty Hollow and report to Yaver Anoom.

The pagans surely err about the most important things, but their religious mishmash contains some gleams of truth. For example, this swamp, besides holy stumps, snags and tussocks, has four sites of power very similar to what we saw on Asee-Teph. Their properties vary, but that doesn't affect our strategy. We must do everything to capture all of the sites and keep them as long as possible while holding back the League. That's not only a matter of pride. Each site of power emits a strong current of mystical energy that helps those who tame it get stronger and more experienced faster. If all four currents are controlled by one side, all Imperial soldiers will gain strength in combat. It's worth fighting for, eh?
While capturing the sites of power controlled by the League, don't forget about ours. Check them just in case - what if the enemy is preparing to recapture?

I can feel the energy of the sites of power fill the air. Now, the earth itself is helping the Empire in combat! Yet it's too early to relax: we can't loosen our grip, or the League will retake all we have in an instant.
Kill the League's priest Gordei Plamenev and report to Timur Blagostin at the Imperial Outpost.

I see Tim wants to report an early execution of the plan as soon as possible, but the lives of the congregation are more important. They're not going anywhere: a week earlier or a week later, they'll get tired of feeding leeches and come to the true teaching and warm food. That was the case with the orcs.
Yet a hostile ideology is a serious business. There must be only one way out of the swamp: the one that leads to us. We need to stop the League's preaching quickly, accurately, efficiently. To paralyze the League's mission, we need to decapitate it. No, not literally - we're not beasts, after all. Send the mission's leader Gordei Plamenev to the Purgatory, and we'll drive away the ordinary preachers.
How are we doing on eliminating the religious and political ignorance? The only hundred percent rate we have for now is mosquito bites.
Artur and you managed to drive away the League's mission, didn't you? Excellent. A complete conversion of the pagans to the Trinity Church is now a question of time.
Kill the League's priest Gordei Plamenev and report to Timur Blagostin at the Imperial Outpost.

To disorganize the operation of the League's mission, we need to efficiently strip it of its leadership. Here's what it means translated from bureaucratic: Gordei Plamenev must stay in the Purgatory. He already resurrected after the previous assassination - it's time to sent him to meet Tensess' servant again. If he rises, we'll send him right back. And we'll keep at it until the ultimate unconditional victory of the Trinity Church!
When words are not enough to persuade, you resort to more forceful arguments. In the long run, these determine what is to be written in history books. Cruel but true.
Gordei got another unscheduled leave, didn't he? That's great. Sooner or later, he'll run out of mirra, and we won't hear about the League's mission for a long time.
Hold the ceremony of handing the insignia to the five newly converted aviaks.

Our wards will no longer wander in the dark. They used to be simple savages from the swamp, yet now they'll be warriors of the Cha Pie-Pie special red-winged company. Good lads! Just between us, they won't make a company. After all those battles, I'm not sure we can count on a platoon of pagans. But there's nothing we can do: they heard the word "company" and really liked it, and now they insist on it. They agreed to join the church and to fight for us, but they insist on being a company. So let them: for a good cause, I can even call them a division.
Who led our boys to the Light? You! Therefore, you'll have the honor of getting them swear the oath. Here are their insignia - give them to the newly-made heroes of the Empire.
Gosh, some scoundrels are still wandering around the swamps, spoiling our figures. If I write 97% conversion rate, it doesn't look good. If I write 100% - what if they check it?
This is how victories are won. Congratulations, plumed warriors, on your being enlisted and taking the path of heroes!
Kill five League heroes and report to Yaver Anoom at the Imperial Campaign Center.

The League found us as fast as we did them, and they're already taking countermeasures. Assaults on our propagandists are becoming more frequent, and recently we began to encounter attempts on the life of commissar Blagostin. Alas, we can formally give up the starry-eyed hopes of joint marches against our common enemy. This is war, and we must defend ourselves.
The League's expedition, like that of ours, included both a team of qualified experts and lots of volunteering heroes. The likes of you. It is them who is now in the way of our propaganda efforts. Exterminate them wherever you face them. After every fifth victory, report to me and receive a well-deserved award.
Be careful! I have no doubt the leaders of the League's expedition offered a similar reward for your head.
Five League heroes defeated? That's great. Here's your award. Sign here and keep up the fight. We don't have a right to relax, not for a minute.
Kill 15 Sermoners of the Church of Light at the swamp and report to Yaver Anoom at the Imperial Campaign Center.

I don't like the elated mood Blagostin brothers are in. Sure, it's tempting - search and destroy the main target and win the war with one beautiful strike. Yet that will never happen. Even if Gordei Plamenev is forever kept in the Purgatory... Even if we chop off his head in a purely barbaric fashion, the mission will not cease to exist as long as there are those who can preach. So roll up your sleeves and go weed the swamp. I'm warning you: it's boring, dirty and dangerous work, and neither one nor a hundred strokes can help us win. But this is the only way to win wars, and it is both long and boring. As a financial incentive, you will receive an award for every fifteen sermoners killed.
Get back to the swamp and continue working against enemy sermoners until you win the ultimate victory.
Fifteen sermoners exterminated? Excellent, you're supposed to get a financial incentive. Sign here in the book and get back to work.
Meet with Louis de Pluie in the League Camp.

Dear God, what's going on?! They say some pagans appeared on the big island! They're not like our healers and druids - those, although they worship the earth, go to the church and venerate Tensess and the holy martyrs. Yet these pagans got into some swamp and stay there, praying to some roots and snags! Shameless bastards! We brought the true Light to them, but they just wouldn't heed! I don't know what I'd do if I got hold of them... I'd pluck their feathers out!
I was told about them by our sermoner Louis de Pluie. Go ask him what's going on. Can this shame be tolerated?
You've been told already, haven't you? Thankless savages! Well, we'll teach those stubborn fools a good lesson.
Kill 15 Pagan Aviaks and report to Gordei Plamenev in the Misty Hollow.

Most natives heeded our admonition and accepted the Light peacefully. Alas, there are always those who won't understand words. For those, I have preaching methods that are easier to understand. Fortunately, father Gordei Plamenev is with us - his sermon can convert even rocks and logs, let alone savages from a swamp.
He's on the spiritual battlefield now - in the swamp where the pagans are hiding. Go there and help him bring the light of the true faith to the stubborn barbarians. But first, prove your resolution. Kill fifteen pagans to strike fear and awe into the others.
Killing pagans is a cruel but necessary step. We crush their bones to save their souls.
The blood of infidels on your hands speaks of your resolution louder than any words. Let's do it then! We'll show those poor bastards what love and humility is!
Show the book found in the swamp to Gordei Plamenev in the Misty Hollow.

What does that pagan have in his bag? A book in the Imperial language! It's soaked with dirty swamp slush, but the cover leaves no questions about its contents: it has the profiles of Nezeb, Skrakan and - hardly discernible - Tensess - embossed on it. Imperial propaganda! We need to show it to Gordei Plamenev and decide what to do about it.

What's that sponge? Imperial propaganda? Found among the pagans' possessions?! May Tensess curse them! Heretics and their dirty lies are already here! We must save the pagans' souls from that devilish nonsense.

Find the pagan aviaks' totem in the Misty Hollow and overturn it to challenge their leader, Stiff-Necked. After defeating the pagan, use the resurrection scroll to raise him and convince him to convert to the Church of Light.

If I were to decide, I'd mix the bird brains of those stubborn fools with swamp slush and put an end to infidelity once and for all. Unfortunately, they learned to hide in the thicket. We don't have enough forces to comb the swamp and capture them all. Besides, our enemy will waste no time. We must find a way to convince them once and for all that our faith is true. Let's try converting their leader, Kemal Stiff-Necked. Once the chief is converted, the others will follow.
First of all, we need to force him to leave cover. Find their last sanctum, a filthy totem, and throw it into the dirt - and he'll come rushing at once. Then kill him. Then do the most important thing: resurrect the pagan by reading this scroll over his corpse. He'll hardly hang on to his misconceptions once he's been in the afterworld and experienced Tensess' kindness.
Go now. May the Light shine upon you and glory to Tensess!

I saw the Light. Everyone listen! The outlander speaks truth, their god is stronger than ours. We should lay down weapons and join the Church of Light. Who stays in swamp, will have no one to blame but them!
Capture the four sites of power in the Misty Hollow and report to Nadine de Blizare.

Why do you think the pagans chose exactly this swamp for their riotous acts? There's a reason for it! Our scouts found four sites of power in the Misty Hollow almost like those on Asee-Teph! Do you realize what that means? Even if we only capture one of them, all the League heroes will be granted a blessing that will allow us to get stronger and more experienced faster. If we capture all four spots, the earth itself will side with us!
The only problem is this: pagan sites of power cannot tell good from evil or right from wrong. If they are captured by the Imperial murderers, the magical support will be theirs! Do you understand how important it is to keep them away from the sites of power?
Go capture all four sites to ensure the League's victory. Our cause is just!
Check the sites already captured by ours, too. Just imagine this horror: you capture an Imperial spot of power while they capture ours!

Can you feel the primal power radiating from these ancient sites? Their energy is so rapturous! Ah, it's too early to celebrate just yet! The Imperial soldiers must be making wicked plans on how to strip us of everything!
Kill Artur Blagostin in the Misty Hollow and report to Gordei Plamenev.

The Imperial heretics are already here, packing the brains and souls of naive pagans with their lies! And who's in charge? The silver-tongued slanderer Blagostin! He'd be better off without his head, but such atrocities are not encouraged. Yet sending him to the Purgatory will be just right. Let him sit there, behold the stone walls, speak with Tensess' Servant - he may repent his misconceptions yet. At the very least, he will get some rest from his unrighteous doings. In the meantime, we'll disable his propaganda machine!

The heretics already got hold of the souls of one of the winged tribes. Now they're preaching to pagans. Who can their next target be? The white-winged ones? No, such filth must be strangled at birth.

Blagostin is in the Purgatory? Excellent, that's where he belongs. While he is getting back from the afterworld, we'll drive away the Imperial propagandists and convert the pagans to the true faith in an instant!
Kill Artur Blagostin in the Misty Hollow and report to Gordei Plamenev.

According to this report, Blagostin already resurrected and is back preaching his heresy. You know what to do. I hear mirra is strictly rationed in the Empire's planned economy, and they have to give an account of every drop used. Let's see how long Blagostin's mirra will last, ha ha ha! And when he comes back from the afterworld, he'll need to write explanatory notes for excessive use of mirra instead of doing his propaganda.
Can you imagine Blagostin offered a reward for my head too?! A crowd of Imperial soldiers came rushing just now, they nearly killed me. Boy, are they mean!
Blagostin is in the afterworld again? That's music to my ears! He'd better get used to it, he's going to be a frequent visitor.
Sprinkle mirra over the five newly converted aviaks.

The infidels' resistance has been overcome. The last hard-headed stubborn fools are still roaming the swamp, but they're going to rot there soon. The aviaks embraced the Light as aided by the one true church, and not by the Imperial schismatics! This is not only through Tensess' grace, but also thanks to you. Your actions saved an entire nation!
Admonish these lucky souls before they begin a new life. Take this flask of mirra and sprinkle it over the fresh converts.
May Tensess rise and may his enemies be wasted!
Only yesterday they rejected the Light, goodness and truth, and today they will crush the skulls of their unbelieving fellow tribesmen! Isn't it a wonder?
Kill 15 mosquitoes near the Imperial Outpost and report to Sookie Dry-Wing.

Parasites! Blood suckers! How long will they drink blood of working aviaks!
No, I don't mean the white-winged now. I mean ordinary blood suckers. When it's hot, whole army of mosquitoes rises up from the swamp. Buzz, buzz, feast on poor ones suffering! They drink and drink, and it's never enough, they swell but never burst. Soon they'll be as big as an aviak and still want more!
Fighting with mosquitoes is like whipping sea. But we have do something. Near the camp, whack ten or more fat mosquitoes that threaten not health but life.
Be brave,hero! I heard you rid Empire of blood suckers - now help the Steel Claw!
I heard the buzzing stop. Good! It would be good if we could do the same to the white feathers...
